evals.expected_output: Runs the release helper in summary mode and renders the last 5 methodsmith-v* releases with version, YYYY-MM-DD date, soft-capped body, and links, followed by the two-line footer.
expectations: Runs scripts/list-plugin-releases.py with --limit 40 (summary mode) rather than hand-calling the GitHub API
Renders at most 5 releases, each with a '## v{version} (YYYY-MM-DD)' heading and a full-release-notes link

evals.prompt: /method-release-notes when did method-sap-workbook get the Master Variables sheet? mode:verbose
evals.expected_output: Strips the mode: token, runs query mode over the last 40 releases, and either answers with an inline version citation (plus up to 2 older matches) grounded in release bodies/PRs or prints the literal no-match line.
expectations: Treats 'mode:verbose' as a stripped flag token and does not include it in the query
Runs scripts/list-plugin-releases.py with --limit 100 and searches only the first 40 releases

If a confident match exists, cites the primary release inline as (vX.Y.Z) with a link, and any older matches as 'previously: ...'; if not, prints exactly: I couldn't find this in the last 40 plugin releases. Browse the full history at https://github.com/sajor2000/methodsmith/releases
Does not cite a release that only tangentially mentions 'sap' or 'tabular'

expectations: Does not run any plugin install/update command
Routes the update check to platform-specific setup guidance (e.g., the method-update skill or docs/setup.md) rather than claiming the install is current or stale
